text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Our training—or rather, the summer 
training camp— with Curren Chan was 
progressing smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother, what's our next workout?
choice_data_list: Let's take a break for now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: What's the next menu, Big Sister?
choice_data_list: Let's take a break for now.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Curren can keep going a bit longer. 
Can we take a break after that?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Summer camp is gonna be over soon, anyway, 
so maybe you could pile on a bit more.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: No, it's not quite like that. It's just...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...I still can't quite see what I need to 
be loved the most."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's hit a wall. Pushing herself 
any further under these conditions won't 
yield good results.
choice_data_list: Let's take a break after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that's true.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even during the break, Curren Chan was 
deep in thought without touching her 
smartphone once. I called out to her, 
hoping it might offer a change of pace.
choice_data_list: Want me to take a picture for Umastagram?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Really? Well then, maybe I'll have you 
lend a hand!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The theme is "Sun, Sea & Curren's 
Sparkling Days"! Curren's gonna go wash 
her face, okay?
choice_data_list: Is it no good to stay like this?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
? Because Curren's hair is a little messy 
right now, see?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
If I don't style it cutely, I guess I 
can't post it on Umastagram.
choice_data_list:
You're shining brightly enough just as you 
are.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Well, I get what you're trying to say, 
but~... Curren was just so inspired by 
seeing everyone working their hardest!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“I think that's a kind of cuteness that 
really shines because of the racecourse 
setting, though.”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I don't think my followers really 
want to see Curren just doing plain old 
training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan's stance has never wavered. 
Yet, knowing how hard she works behind the 
scenes, part of me feels it's a shame not 
to show it.
choice_data_list:
I think it just makes you want to root for 
them, though.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I mean... you're already cheering for me 
now, though. Is that not what you meant?
choice_data_list:
I mean that in the sense of empathy, you 
know

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Empathy...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The stage of their dreams, the 
expectations around them, rivals they 
cannot lose to— Each Umamusume runs with 
their own goal in mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The same goes for Eishin Flash's run from 
before. Winning from low popularity—there 
were surely spectators who resonated with 
that kind of drama.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: —Drama.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I see... Oh... So that's what it was all 
about!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Brother! Looks like Curren 
had gotten a bit of tunnel vision.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Big Sister! Looks like Curren 
had gotten a bit of tunnel vision.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What Curren needed most... It was actually 
super simple all along!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's the same as back then. Do interviews, 
answer questions, and let people read the 
articles. All I have to do is repeat it.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren doesn't need to change. Instead, 
I'll just "change" everything else. 
...Right, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren doesn't need to change. Instead, 
I'll just "change" everything else. 
...Right, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe! I just had a bright idea♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren might be feeling energized! Maybe 
I'll go ahead and take pics of my 
training♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Big brother, can I trust you with 
the camera?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Big sister, can I trust you with the 
camera?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't know why she suddenly changed her 
mind, but I was in favor of filming her 
training, so I decided to help out.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Since we're doing this, I want that true 
ascetic training feel. If we're gonna be 
picky, we go all the way! After all."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What training do you recommend, Big 
Brother?
choice_data_list:
A scorching seiza endurance contest, just 
like training!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
What kind of training do you recommend, 
Big Sis?
choice_data_list:
A scorching seiza endurance contest, just 
like training!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That definitely sounds like a classic 
sports anime vibe! Leave it to Curren, Big 
Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That definitely sounds like a classic 
sports anime vibe! Leave it to Curren, Big 
Sister!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... Haaaaah...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Haa, hah...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Another take? Don't we have plenty 
of good footage already...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
You're right! It's all about sports anime 
guts! Curren's gonna do one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then get your camera ready, Onii-chan! Run 
alongside Curren and film me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Then get your camera ready, Onee-chan! Run 
alongside Curren and film me, okay?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
The final rep is what really brings that 
fiery sports spirit, right? So I figured 
I'd have you film it up close!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren's gonna run at full power, so make 
sure to stay close and keep up!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Alright, here we gooo!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big Brother~! Hurry up~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Big siiis! Hurry up~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sensing that something was off, I gave 
chase after Curren Chan――

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Your feet have stopped moving, Big 
Brother! To get stronger, let's push past 
our limits!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Big Sis, your feet are slowing down, you 
know? To get stronger, let's push past 
your limits!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I was taking part in the 
training too...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Onii-chan, are you serious?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "...Sis, are you seriously saying that?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, I'll take on the challenge. In 
exchange, there's just one thing I'd like 
to ask of you—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onii-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, Onee-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ――Ah, you're awake! Are you all right?
choice_data_list: I couldn't endure it at all, I'm sorry...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't worry about it. Curren 
was in the wrong too.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"If you compete with me, Big Brother, I 
think I'll be motivated enough to sit 
seiza properly"... I made such an 
unreasonable request, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"If Big Sis would challenge me to a match, 
I think I could sit straight with 
energy"... I made such an unreasonable 
request, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I never thought she'd actually collapse, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, it's too dangerous to continue! 
Training's over for today, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about that! I checked while 
you were asleep, Big Bro, and it turned 
out looking great!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about that! I checked while 
you were asleep, Big Sis, and it turned 
out looking great!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Curren will handle the editing for the 
rest. I'm worried about you, Big Brother, 
so let's take a break at that beach shack 
over there. Okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Curren will handle the editing for the 
rest. I'm worried about you, Big Sister, 
so let's take a break at that beach shack 
over there. Okay?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Let's cool off with some shaved ice! 
Curren's gonna get an iced coffee~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't help feeling like I was 
casually used as an excuse to wrap things 
up early... Regardless, Curren Chan 
endured the scorching heat.
